thag16.8:1.1: Gacchaṃ vadesi samaṇa ṭhito 'mhi mamañ ca brūsi ṭhitam aṭṭhito 'ti; pucchāmi taṃ samaṇa etam atthaṃ: kasmā ṭhito tvaṃ aham aṭṭhito 'mhi. || ||
thag16.8:2.1: ṭhito ahaṃ Aṅgulimāla sabbadā sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ, tvañ ca pāṇesu asaññato 'si, tasmā ṭhito 'haṃ tuvam aṭṭhito 'si. || ||
thag16.8:3.1: cirassaṃ vata me mahito mahesi mahāvanaṃ samaṇo paccupādi; so 'haṃ cajissāmi sahassapāpaṃ sutvāna gāthaṃ tava dhammayuttaṃ. || ||
thag16.8:4.1: itv eva coro asim āvudhañ ca sobbhe papāte narake anvakāsi, avandi coro sugatassa pāde, tatth' eva pabbajjam ayāci buddhaṃ. || ||
thag16.8:5.1: buddho ca kho kāruṇiko mahesi yo satthā lokassa sadevakassa tam ehi bhikkhū 'ti tadā avoca; es' eva tassa ahu bhikkhubhāvo. || ||
thag16.8:6.1: yo pubbe pamajjitvāna pacchā so na ppamajjati, so 'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti abbhā mutto va candimā. || ||
thag16.8:7.1: yassa pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ kusalena pithīyati, so 'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti abbhā mutto va candimā. || ||
thag16.8:8.1: yo have daharo bhikkhu yuñjatī buddhasāsane, so 'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti abbhā mutto va candimā. || ||
thag16.8:9.1: disā hi me dhammakathaṃ suṇantu, disā hi me yuñjantu buddhasāsane, disā hi me te manusse bhajantu ye dhammam evādapayanti santo. || ||
thag16.8:10.1: disā hi me khantivādānaṃ avirodhappasaṃsinaṃ suṇantu dhammaṃ kālena tañ ca anuvidhīyantu. || ||
thag16.8:11.1: na hi jātu so mamaṃ hiṃse aññaṃ vā pana kañcinaṃ, pappuyya paramaṃ santiṃ rakkheyya tasathāvare. || ||
thag16.8:12.1: udakaṃ hi nayanti nettikā, usukārā namayanti tejanaṃ, dāruṃ namayanti tacchakā, attānaṃ damayanti paṇḍitā. || ||
thag16.8:13.1: daṇḍen' eke damayanti aṅkusehi kasāhi ca; adaṇḍena asatthena ahaṃ danto 'mhi tādinā. || ||
thag16.8:14.1: Ahiṃsako 'ti me nāmaṃ hiṃsakassa pure sato; ajjāhaṃ saccanāmo 'mhi, na naṃ hiṃsāmi kañcinaṃ. || ||
thag16.8:15.1: coro ahaṃ pure āsiṃ Aṅgulimālo 'ti vissuto, vuyhamāno mahoghena buddhaṃ saraṇam āgamaṃ. || ||
thag16.8:16.1: lohitapāṇi pure āsiṃ Aṅgulimālo 'ti vissuto; saraṇāgamanaṃ passa; bhavanetti samūhatā. || ||
thag16.8:17.1: tādisaṃ kammaṃ katvāna bahuṃ duggatigāminaṃ phuṭṭho kammavipākena anaṇo bhuñjāmi bhojanaṃ. || ||
thag16.8:18.1: pamādam anuyuñjanti bālā dummedhino janā, appamādañ ca medhāvī dhanaṃ seṭṭhaṃ va rakkhati. || ||
thag16.8:19.1: mā pamādam anuyuñjetha mā kāmaratisanthavaṃ, appamatto hi jhāyanto pappoti paramaṃ sukhaṃ. || ||
thag16.8:20.1: svāgataṃ nāpagataṃ, n' etaṃ dummantitaṃ mama; saṃvibhattesu dhammesu yaṃ seṭṭhaṃ tad upāgamaṃ. || ||
thag16.8:21.1: svāgataṃ nāpagataṃ n' etaṃ dummantitaṃ mama; tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thag16.8:22.1: araññe rukkhamūle vā pabbatesu guhāsu vā tattha tatth' eva aṭṭhāsiṃ ubbiggamanaso tadā. || ||
thag16.8:23.1: sukhaṃ sayāmi ṭhāyāmi, sukhaṃ kappemi jīvitaṃ ahatthapāso Mārassa: aho satthānukampito. || ||
thag16.8:24.1: brahmajacco pure āsiṃ, udicco ubhato ahuṃ, so 'jja putto sugatassa dhammarājassa satthuno, || ||
thag16.8:25.1: vītataṇho anādāno guttadvāro susaṃvuto; aghamūlaṃ vamitvāna patto me āsavakkhayo. || ||
thag16.8:26.1: pariciṇṇo mayā satthā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ, ohito garuko bhāro, bhavanetti samūhatā 'ti. || || Aṅgulimālo thero.
